name: External Mandate Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the external mandate processing reason code in the format of character string with a maximum length of 4 characters.|The list of valid codes is an external code list published separately.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

AC01.name: Incorrect Account Number
AC01.definition: Format of the account number specified is not correct

AC04.name: Closed Account Number
AC04.definition: Account number specified has been closed on the Receiver's books

AC06.name: Blocked Account
AC06.definition: Account specified is blocked, prohibiting posting of transactions against it.

AG01.name: Transaction Forbidden
AG01.definition: Transaction forbidden on this type of account (formerly NoAgreement)

AG02.name: Invalid Bank Operation Code
AG02.definition: Bank Operation code specified in the message is not valid for receiver

AM02.name: Not Allowed Amount
AM02.definition: Specific transaction/message amount is greater than allowed maximum

AM03.name: Not Allowed Currency
AM03.definition: Specified message amount is a non processable currency outside of existing agreement

BE01.name: Inconsistent With End Customer
BE01.definition: Identification of end customer is not consistent with associated account number. (formerly CreditorConsistency).

BE04.name: Missing Creditor Address
BE04.definition: Specification of creditor's address, which is required for payment, is missing/not correct (formerly IncorrectCreditorAddress).

BE05.name: Unrecognised Initiating Party
BE05.definition: Party who initiated the message is not recognised by the end customer

BE06.name: Unknown End Customer
BE06.definition: End customer specified is not known at associated Sort/National Bank Code or does no longer exist in the books

BE07.name: Missing Debtor Address
BE07.definition: Specification of debtor's address, which is required for payment, is missing/not correct.

MD02.name: Missing Mandatory Information In Mandate
MD02.definition: Mandate related information data required by the scheme is missing.

MD08.name: No Mandate Service By Agent
MD08.definition: Receiving agent does not offer specified Mandate services

MD09.name: No Mandate Service On Customer
MD09.definition: Account is not open to specified Mandates services

MD10.name: No Mandate Service For Specified
MD10.definition: Account is not open to specified Mandates services for this particular creditor

MD11.name: Unrecognised Agent
MD11.definition: Agent to whom the message needs to be forwarded cannot be located

MD12.name: Not Unique Mandate Reference
MD12.definition: Mandate identification is not unique to the creditor

MD13.name: Incorrect Customer Authentication
MD13.definition: There is a problem with the customer authentication

MD14.name: Incorrect Agent
MD14.definition: Agent in the payment workflow is incorrect

MD15.name: Incorrect Currency
MD15.definition: Currency of the transaction is incorrect

MD18.name: Requested By Initiating Party And Customer
MD18.definition: Cancellation/amendment requested by the creditor and the debtor

MD19.name: Mandate Cancelled Due To Early Settlement
MD19.definition: Mandate cancellation following early reimbursement of the debit by the debtor

MD21.name: Mandate Cancelled Due To Fraud
MD21.definition: Mandate cancellation due to suspected fraud

MD22.name: Mandate Initiation Cancelled
MD22.definition: Mandate cancellation following mandate initiation cancellation

MD23.name: Mandate Amendment Cancelled
MD23.definition: Mandate cancellation following mandate amendment cancellation

MS02.name: Not Specified Reason Customer Generated
MS02.definition: Reason has not been specified by end customer

MS03.name: Not Specified Reason Agent Generated
MS03.definition: Reason has not been specified by agent.

NARR.name: Narrative
NARR.definition: Reason is provided as narrative information in the additional reason information.

RC01.name: Bank Identifier Incorrect
RC01.definition: Bank Identifier code specified in the message has an incorrect format (formerly IncorrectFormatForRoutingCode).

RF01.name: Not Unique Transaction Reference
RF01.definition: Transaction reference is not unique within the message.

RR01.name: Missing Debtor Account Or Identification
RR01.definition: Specification of the debtor’s account or unique identification needed for reasons of regulatory requirements is insufficient or missing

RR02.name: Missing Debtor Name Or Address
RR02.definition: Specification of the debtor’s name and/or address needed for regulatory requirements is insufficient or missing.

RR03.name: Missing Creditor Name Or Address
RR03.definition: Specification of the creditor’s name and/or address needed for regulatory requirements is insufficient or missing.

SL01.name: Specific Service Offered By Debtor Agent
SL01.definition: Due to specific service offered by the Debtor Agent

SL11.name: Creditor Not On Whitelist Of Debtor
SL11.definition: Whitelisting service offered by the Debtor Agent; Debtor has not included the Creditor on its “Whitelist” (yet). In the Whitelist the Debtor may list all allowed Creditors to debit Debtor bank account.

SL12.name: Creditor On Blacklist Of Debtor
SL12.definition: Blacklisting service offered by the Debtor Agent; Debtor included the Creditor on his “Blacklist”. In the Blacklist the Debtor may list all Creditors not allowed to debit Debtor bank account.

SL13.name: Maximum Number Of Direct Debit Transactions Exceeded
SL13.definition: Due to Maximum allowed Direct Debit Transactions per period service offered by the Debtor Agent.

SL14.name: Maximum Direct Debit Transaction Amount Exceeded
SL14.definition: Due to Maximum allowed Direct Debit Transaction amount service offered by the Debtor Agent.
